description: The explicit rejection of indexed embeddings with a draft model occurs after a reachable draft prefill call.
trigger: An uncached job uses a draft model and has a synthetic embedding ID in a nonempty prompt-prefill slice.
expected_behavior: Reject the unsupported combination before sending synthetic IDs into the draft model.
actual_behavior: Generator.iterate calls Job.prefill first. Job.prefill calls draft_model.prefill without indexed_embeddings, allowing the draft embedding module to take ordinary vocabulary lookup for IDs starting at one billion. The later assertion in iterate_draftmodel_gen cannot prevent that earlier lookup.

verification.description: Searched generator prefill callers and inspected iteration ordering, both draft prefill sites, model dispatch and the changed embedding fallback. The direct Job.prefill caller is Generator.iterate; the other draft prefill site follows drafting and its new assertion.
verification.limits: No model execution or exact backend exception was observed. Fully cached prompts and prompts whose synthetic IDs are outside the prefill slice do not establish this trigger.

introductions.rationale: 216 enables indexed embedding IDs through jobs and the main model, but its new draft-model rejection follows the existing draft prefill call, which does not receive indexed_embeddings. Task diff and parent call ordering are preserved in the transcript.
